Class FileDataStore.WordEntry

java.lang.Object
backend.storage.FileDataStore.WordEntry
Enclosing class:
FileDataStore
public static class FileDataStore.WordEntry extends Object
Represents a single word entry loaded from words.json.

This lightweight data carrier mirrors the JSON schema used for stored word bank entries.
